$comment: Pre-game options. Copy counts start from a pool file and can be edited per card in the setup screen.

warzones.description: Adds the Warzone deck, Active Warzone slot and the Warzones pool section.

leaders.description: False = No Leaders mode: removes Leader-class Units, both Leader Nodes and leader-related cards. Champions stay and use Unit Nodes.

deckMode.description: Standard = pool counts. TrueSingleton = every enabled card x1. RandomDraw = virtual decks: every draw picks a random enabled card of that deck type (uniform per card); no deck runs out.

archons.description: Archons module: once per game each player may take an Archon draw at Start-up (see 3, keep 1, draw one card fewer). Off by default.

spacecraft.description: Spacecraft module: adds the 'spacecraft' pool section (ships into the Unit deck, Orders into the Order deck) and, with Warzones on, the 'spacecraftWarzones' section. Off by default. See design/spacecraft.md.

leaderRelatedNotes.No Gods, No Masters: Its condition (empty Leader Node) would always be true without Leader Nodes, so it's removed.
leaderRelatedNotes.Archons: The Unnameable and Androsiar are Leaders; Ceasefire and Deify need Leaders.
leaderRelatedNotes.Spacecraft: The 6 Leader spacecraft are Leader-class Units, so No Leaders mode already removes them (S25). No other spacecraft card needs listing.
